children: Contango Silver & Gold released a Technical Report Summary for the Kitsault Valley Project with an updated mineral resource (effective Sept 11, 2026) showing 7.660 Mt Indicated and 6.305 Mt Inferred resources.
Published TRS (issue date Sept 21, 2026) and made corporate presentation available on company website.
Indicated resources: 7.660 Mt containing 58.698 Moz Ag, 394.700 koz Au (89.545 Moz AgEq).
Inferred resources: 6.305 Mt containing 22.804 Moz Ag, 620.817 koz Au (64.920 Moz AgEq); no Measured resources or reserves.
Update increases Indicated tonnage 84.4% and Indicated AgEq 93.1% vs. 2023; Inferred AgEq decreased 25.1% vs. 2023.
QP recommends staged work: complete 2026 assays, 2027 MRE update, metallurgical tests and an Initial Assessment targeting late Q2 2027.
